  "title": "Head, Human Resources",
  "description": "Electronic Payplus Limited is a leading Nigerian smart?card and electronic payment solutions provider with over two decades of industry excellence. Incorporated in 2004 and operational since 2005, the company has evolved from POS deployment into Nigeria&rsquo;s foremost secure card manufacturer and payment solution specialist. It operates the country&rsquo;s only purpose?built smart card personalization bureau, with industry?scale capacity and world?class quality standards.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Head, Human Resources&nbsp;

Job Location: Ibeju Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary


	This role is responsible for ensuring effective, efficient management of employees and the satisfaction of all staff in the various departments and units, from entry to exit.
	Attract and retain qualified and motivated staff efficiently and cost- effectively.
	Ensure that the recruited staff remain &lsquo;fit for purpose&rsquo; throughout the duration of their tenure in the organization.
	Work with supervisors to ensure equity and equal opportunity in the workplace.
	Provide competitive and desirable compensation and benefit packages for all staff, and provide upward mobility and career advancement opportunities based on merit and job performance.
	Provide and coordinate training and development programmes that will enhance and improve the performance of staff, processes, and the organization as a whole.
	Implement an effective Performance Management Process and clearly demonstrate its culture in the workplace.
	Provide supervision and direction to Human Resources employees as well as streamline processes for operational effectiveness.


Responsibilities


	Talent Acquisition and Management:&nbsp;Recruitment and selection process administration, onboarding new staff, Effective headcount management, providing guidance and input on business unit restructuring, workforce planning, and succession planning. Participate in the evaluation and monitoring of the success of training programs. Follow up to ensure training objectives are met.
	Performance Management: Overseeing strategies, planning performance to achieve goals, reviewing, assessing progress, developing knowledge, skills, and abilities to manage employee performance to increase productivity and help achieve organizational objectives by setting individual and team goals which are aligned to the strategic goals of the organization.
	Compensation and Benefits: Provide input for developing the company budget and monitor departmental utilization. Payroll Administration: Implementation of a welfare and benefits package.
	Employee Relations: Implementing employee well-being initiatives, providing HR Policy guidance and interpretation, and maintaining and updating policy manuals and employee handbooks as needed. In-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to day- to-day management of employees, reducing legal risks and ensuring regulatory compliance. Partner with the legal department as needed/required, manage, and resolve complex employee relations issues.
	HR Administration: Employee file and data management &ndash; creation, maintenance and storage of records, effective HR reporting for business decisions: tracking and reporting of monthly leave utilization Reports, Tracking and monitoring of all statutory requirements to ensure they are done within SLA &ndash; tax and pension remittance, ITF, registration of all staff on GLI, medical scheme, liaise with appropriate agencies and bodies to ensure smooth relationship between the company, the communities and the Government.
	Learning and Development: Managing skills enhancement and professional development programmes within the allocated budget, managing the design and delivery of training programmes in accordance with the needs of the Company, evaluating the effectiveness of all training and L&amp;D activities to identify areas of improved performance and to feed into plans, providing reports to management identifying L&amp;D trends and return on investment analyses.
	Business Partnering and Organizational Development (Performance Management and Engagement): Conductmonthly meetings with respective business units and consult with line management, providing HR guidance when appropriate.HR metrics measurement, monitoring, and tracking; implement culture change processes; work closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale, increase productivity and retention; conduct the performance management process within the group of assigned responsibility; collect ongoing information regarding employee satisfaction with salary packages and wages, working conditions, etc.; implement tactical plans targeted at improving employee performance and engagement.


Management and Supervisory:


	Checks on teams to be sure that any issues with working tools, personnel, safety, etc., are addressed promptly.
	Coaching and developing staff while fostering a team atmosphere. Provides pep talks as needed and coaching for any performance issues.
	Assists employees with questions or problems regarding work assignments, priorities, safety, personnel issues, etc.
	Counsel employees when necessary and apply personnel actions such as disciplinary action, transfer, promotion, termination of employment, etc. Documents any issues, counselling efforts, etc.
	Oversees training and orientation of new employees and offers additional training as needed. Offers re-training when necessary. Sets up and maintains cross-training, as applicable.
	Serves as a role model to all employees. Conducts oneself professionally and abides by Company safety &amp; personnel policies, SOPs, etc.
	Analyzes budgets, continuously controls HR costs, and identify/rectify waste measures.
	Checks HR output according to expectations and submits reports on performance and progress.
	Conducts safety and orientation training with new employees.
	Control and organize timesheets for personnel.
	Identify issues of inefficiency, suggest and take action on improvements.
	Review the sales team&#39;s goals daily and identify the root cause if the goal was not obtained.
	Work with line managers to set Performance expectations and targets for employees&rsquo; performance.
	Conduct employee performance appraisals and communicate information to Executive Management.


Key Result Areas
The key result areas of this role are:


	Staff productivity and performance aligned to corporate strategies of the Company.
	Optimization, control, and reduction of staff cost.
	Effectiveness and efficiency of&nbsp;recruitment
	Effectiveness/swiftness in closing the manning gap and succession plan.
	Staff discipline and grievance management
	Staff ethical conduct, attitude, and alignment with corporate philosophy and values
	Staff bonding, welfare, and work-life balance.
	Efficiency and effectiveness of staff retention/attrition rate
	Quality and adequacy of training/development program
	Efficiency in payroll administration


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor&#39;s Degree with 7 - 15 years of work experience and must reside around Ajah and its environs.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their Applications and CV to: recruitment@epayplusng.com using the&nbsp;Job Position as the subject of the email.&nbsp;

        Oxymon Solutions Limited is a financial services company providing a range of financial solutions to individuals, civil servants, professionals, and business owners. Our services include loans for civil servants and private-sector customers, NIN registration and related services, credit status services, utility services, savings, fixed deposits, and other financial solutions designed to meet the diverse needs of our customers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



 Job Position: Experienced Sales / Loan Officer

Job Summary


	We are looking for an experienced and result-driven Sales/ Loan Officer to join our team.
	The ideal candidate must have solid experience in sales, preferably within a microfinance bank or financial institution, with a proven ability to generate leads, acquire customers, and meet sales targets.


Responsibilities


	Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve assigned targets.
	Identify and acquire new customers and business opportunities.
	Promote the bank’s products and services to prospective and existing customers.
	Build and maintain strong customer relationships.

	Prepare regular sales and performance reports.
	Meet and exceed assigned sales targets.

	B.Sc. in Business Administration, Accounting, Marketing, Economics, Finance, or a related field.

 Job Position: Senior Human Resources Manager 

Job Location: Onitsha, Anambra
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	If you are passionate about delivering excellent results and advancing your career in the financial service sector, this is where you belong. Join the organization that values your growth and development and gives you the opportunity to build a rewarding career.


Purpose of the Role
     

            
    




	The successful candidate will be responsible for driving HR strategy, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, training and development, HR policies, compliance, and other people-related initiatives that support the Bank's growth and operational objectives.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement HR policies, procedures and people-management strategies.
	Lead recruitment, selection, onboarding and workforce planning activities.
	Manage employee relations, disciplinary processes and workplace grievances.
	Drive performance management, appraisal and employee engagement initiatives.
	Identify training needs and coordinate staff training and development programmes.
	Maintain accurate employee records and ensure proper HR documentation.
	Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, regulations and internal policies.
	Advise management on employee-related matters and support effective decision-making.
	Develop and monitor HR metrics, reports and workforce-related data.
	Support organisational culture, staff retention and employee welfare initiatives.
	Manage payroll inputs, leave administration and other HR operations where applicable.
	Provide leadership and guidance to junior HR/administrative staff.


Qualification & Experience


	Bachelor's Degree/HND in human resources, industrial relations, business administration, management, psychology or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant HR experience, preferably within a microfinance bank,commercial bank, financial institution or other regulated organization.
	Professional HR certification such as CIPM, SHRM, HRCI or equivalentis an advantage, and an MSc in related fields
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian employment practices and HR compliance.
	Demonstrable experience in recruitment, employee relations, performance management and training.
	Experience working with HR policies, documentation and HR reporting.
	Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
	Knowledge of the Anambra business/workforce environment and languages is an advantage.

        Excellent Jobs - Our client, a finance Company Licensed by CBN, is recruiting to fill the position below:  

Job Position: Business Development Executive

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	As the Business Development Executive, you will drive revenue growth by identifying new opportunities, expand the business by developing strategic client relationships, and leading business development initiatives to expand the organization’s market presence and product wise.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Drive new business acquisition and revenue growth while maintaining strong relationships with existing and prospective clients
	Develop and implement business development strategies to expand market reach and increase client acquisition
	Lead, guide, and monitor the business development team to achieve assigned growth and revenue targets
	Analyze market trends, identify business opportunities, and provide sales performance insights and reports to management
	Work closely with internal teams to ensure effective service delivery, client satisfaction, and successful conversion of business opportunities
	Monitor assigned customer accounts and identify early signs of repayment challenges.
	Follow up with customers on repayment obligations where required.
	Ensure that customer applications meet established eligibility requirements.
	Monitor customers after disbursement and maintain regular contact.
	Collect and review required customer documentation before submitting applications.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	New customers acquired.
	Monthly / quarterly business volume generated.
	Loan / product disbursement achieved.
	Revenue generated.
	Number and quality of qualified leads generated.
	Customer retention rate.
	Portfolio quality and repayment performance.Conversion rate from leads to customers.
	Achievement of assigned sales targets.
	Customer satisfaction.
	Compliance with company policies and procedures.
	Quality and timeliness of reports.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor's Degree / HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline
	1–5 years of experience in business development, sales, relationship management or financial services is an advantage.
	Relevant professional qualifications or certifications are an added advantage.
	Experience in loan marketing and customer acquisition especially finance house is desirable.


Required Skills & Competencies:


	Strong sales and business development skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Customer relationship management.
	Negotiation and persuasion skills.
	Strong networking and prospecting abilities.
	Good knowledge of financial products and services.
	Target-oriented and results-driven.
	Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Good reporting and documentation skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant business software.
	High level of integrity and professionalism.


Personal Attributes:


	Self-motivated and proactive.
	Customer-focused.
	Result-oriented.
	Persuasive and confident.
	Honest and trustworthy.
	Resilient and able to work under pressure.
	Willingness to travel for market / customer visits.
	Strong sense of responsibility and accountability.


Working Conditions:


	The role may involve significant fieldwork, customer visits, market development activities, networking events, and office-based reporting.
	The employee is expected to meet assigned business targets and maintain professional relationships with customers and business partners.
